title: Button
script:
// Button (ds-metrics §1 — MainButton / LinkButton): capsule 52 (standard) / 42 (compact) high, padding h md,
// label displayAction / displayActionCompact. primary = accent fill + onAccent, secondary = bg1Elevated + el12, ghost = text only,
// disabled = bg3 + el6. Press: scale 0.96 + opacity 0.9 on self.pressed (@motion.press). loading keeps the width
// (label fades out) and shows a 24pt Loader in the label color; taps are ignored while loading or disabled.
param title: string
param style: "primary" | "secondary" | "ghost" = "primary"
param size: "standard" | "compact" = "standard"
param icon: icon? = null
param loading: bool = false
param enabled: bool = true
event tap
let fill = style == "ghost" ? alpha(@color.bg1, 0) : !enabled ? @color.bg3 : style == "primary" ? @color.accentPrimary : @color.bg1Elevated
let ink = !enabled ? @color.el6 : style == "primary" ? @color.onAccent : style == "secondary" ? @color.el12 : @color.el16
let live = enabled && !loading
